SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_LegalEntityAccountRole_TRY] AS
BEGIN


--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityAccountRole 
AS
(
SELECT
BTL.ID AS CustomerAccountId
,BTL.INSERT_DTTM AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,VALUE AS LegalEntityAccountRoleId
,NULL AS LegalEntityAccountRoleNote
,'TRY' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,BTL.BNK_CODE AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERTDTTM
FROM BUSC.TRY_LegalEntity BTL
CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(BTL.ROLES, ',')
where BTL.STATUS != 'Disabled'
AND BTL.ISLATEST = 1
AND (BTL.ROLES LIKE '%Client%' OR BTL.ROLES LIKE '%CounterParty%')
AND (BTL.FULL_NAME not like 'GROUP-%' OR BTL.FULL_NAME not like 'SETTLEMENT BANK%')

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityAccountRole FROM TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityAccountRole ;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityAccountRole_SRC
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerAccountId)
,CONVERT(DATE,PeriodStartTimestamp)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,LegalEntityAccountRoleId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, SOURCESYSTEMCODE
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityAccountRole 
),

TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityAccountRole_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerAccountId)
,CONVERT(DATE,PeriodStartTimestamp)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,LegalEntityAccountRoleId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, SOURCESYSTEMCODE
FROM BNKM.LegalEntityAccountRole 
WHERE PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31'
),


TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityAccountRole_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
,ISNULL(SRC.SOURCESYSTEMCODE,TGT.SOURCESYSTEMCODE) AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,CASE
	WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
    WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
    ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityAccountRole_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityAccountRole_TGT TGT
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = TGT.SOURCESYSTEMCODE
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityAccountRole_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityAccountRole_DELTA;

--UPDATE RECORDS TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT
SET
PeriodEndTimestamp = DATEADD(DAY,-1,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp)))
FROM BNKM.LegalEntityAccountRole TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityAccountRole_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId 
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND DELTA.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = TGT.SOURCESYSTEMCODE 
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityAccountROle SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = TGT.SOURCESYSTEMCODE
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31'


--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.LegalEntityAccountRole(
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,LegalEntityAccountRoleId
,LegalEntityAccountRoleNote
,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID
,WORKFLOWID
,TASKRUNID
,INSERTDTTM
)

SELECT
SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,SRC.LegalEntityAccountRoleId AS LegalEntityAccountRoleId
,NULL AS LegalEntityAccountRoleNote
,'TRY' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,SRC.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID 
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,SRC.INSERTDTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityAccountRole SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityAccountRole_DELTA DELTA
 ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId 
 AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId 
 AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode 
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS in ('UPDATE','INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityAccountRole;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_LegalEntityAccountRole_DELTA;
END
GO

SELECT PeriodEndTimestamp, COUNT(1) FOR_UPDATE FROM BNKM.LegalEntityAccountRole
WHERE PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL 
    OR PeriodEndTimestamp LIKE '1900%' 
    OR PeriodEndTimestamp LIKE '2099%' 
    OR PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-01-01'
GROUP BY PeriodEndTimestamp;

UPDATE BNKM.LegalEntityAccountRole
SET PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31'
WHERE PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL 
    OR PeriodEndTimestamp LIKE '1900%' 
    OR PeriodEndTimestamp LIKE '2099%' 
    OR PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-01-01';

SELECT PeriodEndTimestamp, COUNT(1) FOR_UPDATE FROM BNKM.LegalEntityAccountRole
WHERE PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL 
    OR PeriodEndTimestamp LIKE '1900%' 
    OR PeriodEndTimestamp LIKE '2099%' 
    OR PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-01-01'
GROUP BY PeriodEndTimestamp;
